review_evidence: Listed all 140 files in the unit scope.
Ran a declaration grep (lemma, theorem, definition, fun, primrec, inductive, datatype, locale, class, axiomatization, consts) over all 140 files and read every low-count file's declarations.
Read completely: src/Tools/Haskell/Test.thy, src/Tools/Haskell/Haskell.thy, src/Tools/Profiling.thy, src/Tools/SML/Examples.thy, src/Tools/Code_Generator.thy, src/ZF/ZFC.thy.
Checked earlier reviews of isabelle-prover__mirror-isabelle: theories whose body is only Standard ML system code were excluded.

rules.content_invariant: The theory body consists only of generate_file / compile_generated_files / export_generated_files commands or ML / ML_command blocks for system infrastructure, with no Isabelle logical declaration.
evidence: src/Tools/Haskell/Haskell.thy (3931 lines): 34 generate_file commands emitting Haskell modules Isabelle/Bytes.hs through Isabelle/Cache.hs (XML, YXML, Server, Bash, Options, Isabelle_Thread), then export_generated_files; no lemma or definition.
src/Tools/Haskell/Test.thy: imports Haskell with condition ISABELLE_GHC_STACK; only compile_generated_files with an ML function that runs 'isabelle ghc_stack build'.
src/Tools/Profiling.thy: one ML block defining structure Profiling (locale/theorem counts, ML heap sizeof statistics, args.yxml/result.yxml I/O) and ML_command Profiling.main ().
rules.rationale: These theories are Isabelle system tooling: they generate the Isabelle/Haskell PIDE support library, run a GHC stack build of it, or implement ML heap and locale profiling. They contain no lemma, definition, or other formal mathematical statement.

summary: Scope src/@subtrees/b holds 140 theory files, mostly ZF set theory, Cube, and HOL tool theories with mathematical declarations; all are retained except three Isabelle system-tooling theories whose bodies are only Haskell library generation, a GHC build test, or ML profiling code with no formal statements.
